_comment: EVER-ISSUED edge_id ledger (edge_id -> {from, to}), checked by evals/append-only-ids.eval.mjs. An edge may be REMOVED from game-core/content/evolution_paths/*.ron, but its entry here is never deleted, and an edge_id is never reused or reassigned to a different (from, to). A live edge_id missing here, or whose from/to differ from its entry, fails. Maintain by hand from the RON.
